On the machine that is joining, as root:

  sudo caramelo machine join hub.example.com:4021 --token 0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0

  hub         hub
  public key  aGVsbG8gaHViIGtleQ==
  expires     2026-09-10T13:00:00Z
good for one machine, stored only as a hash: this is the only time it can be printed
